text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Mmm~! That was suuuper fun! It was every 
bit the masterpiece people said it was!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(An ultra-arrogant, 'I am the king' 
protagonist might divide opinions, but I'm 
totally all for it. Sticking to your own 
aesthetics right to the very end is 
honestly so thrilling.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Oh, isn't that Lala?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. Don't tell me you're 
here for that too?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san! Yes, I've been wanting to 
watch it for the longest time— Hehe, it 
was just as fascinating as I'd hoped.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I see. I just happened to have some free 
time. It was a spontaneous decision, but I 
found it quite interesting to watch.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I did have some doubts about the 
protagonist's behavior. They seemed quite 
overconfident, to say the least..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming strength certainly has its 
charm. However, that power won't last 
forever. Wouldn't you say it's important 
to stay conscious of the end that will 
come one day?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I see. Personally, I thought that 
tyrannical aura had some nice flair to it, 
but—hm?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I just wondered if Alv-san was 
here to see the same movie, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A movie...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No. Just passing by. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "This man is strong 'on his own'"...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can only get strong because you're 
alone, right? It's so self-evident that I 
don't even feel like watching.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Are we done here? Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how intriguing. I suppose everyone 
interprets art in their own way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I suppose everyone has 
different things they hold dear...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still, maybe it wouldn't hurt to pay 
closer attention. To who cares about what, 
and why.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure that will show in my running as 
well...!)
